shortDescription: Check for changes and deploy to devices (FTD, ASA, IOS devices) on Cisco Defense Orchestrator (CDO).

options.name: api_key
options.description: This is the CDO tenant's API token.

options.name: deploy
options.description: Deploy pending configs (Changes staged in CDO) to running devices

options.name: pending
options.description: Just return the pending configs (Changes staged in CDO) but DO NOT DEPLOY to any devices

options.name: region
options.description: This is the CDO region where the tenant exists.
